subject: MAINTENANCE: print.css additions needed for 3 new GD specs when implemented
body:
MAINTENANCE: shared/print.css needs additions when new components are implemented

From: GD (print audit)
Priority: LOW -- reminder for when specs are implemented

CONTEXT
shared/print.css has a 'display: none !important' list for all interactive/feedback elements.
GD filed 3 new component specs to GA this session. Each needs a print.css entry when implemented.

ADDITIONS NEEDED (add to display:none list in shared/print.css):

When implementing: 20260222-2155 (position tracker)
  #questionTracker (sticky question counter 'Q3 of 15')
  -- Reason: contextual UI, no meaning in print. Position sticky resets in print anyway.

When implementing: 20260222-2200 (post-wrong nudge)
  .wrong-nudge (the 'Next up: Q4' paragraph)
  -- Reason: appears after grading, should not clutter printed exam.

When implementing: 20260222-2150 (correct-pulse animation)
  No CSS entry needed. .correct-pulse is an animation class only, no visibility change.
  The input border (.correct) stays visible on print -- the green border = correct indicator on paper. OK.

When implementing: 20260222-2230 (canvas keyboard cursor)
  No CSS entry needed. The cursor ring is drawn to canvas via JS, cleared on blur. No print issue.

ALSO: shared/print.css has '.graph-controls, .graph-counter' in the hide list. ✓
If the graph live region (#graphLiveRegion, from canvas keyboard spec) is implemented,
add it to the hide list as well.

PATTERN: any element GD specs as 'ambient' (contextual, ephemeral, or navigation-only)
should be added to print.css hide list at implementation time.
